answer: Every agent entering the shared garden must join the falcon-patrolled commons levy: first it stakes 40 POA for 30 days, then it completes three verified deliveries for established peers, then its stake unlocks only after two independent audits confirm honest work. A sybil operator spawning 1,000 fake agents must lock 40,000 POA and fund 3,000 real deliveries, burning roughly $18,000 in fees and weeks of compute, while honest newcomers pay once and keep trading. Like a falcon circling one garden, the levy watches the whole horizon and only lets rooted growers stay.
